sections.A: Cerebral palsy movement aur posture ke mustaqil masle hain jo paidaish se pehle, dauraan ya foran baad dimagh ki chot se hote hain. Dimagh ki chot nahi barhti, lekin muscles aur haddiyon ke masle bachche ke barhne ke saath barh sakte hain.
sections.B: Milestones mein der, tone ki tabdeeli, panjon par chalna, taangon ka cross hona aur ek taraf ka farq. Ghar walon se baat kar ke bachche ke goals samjhein.
sections.D: GMFCS se functional level, GMFM se progress, Ashworth ya Tardieu se spasticity, range, chaal ki video aur hip X-ray ki nigrani.
sections.G: Pehle seekhi hui salahiyat khatam hona: yeh CP nahi, koi barhti bimari ho sakti hai. Naya hip dard, khansi ke saath nigalne mein masla ya lamba daura: urgent.
sections.H: Pehle yaqeen karein ke bimari barh nahi rahi, phir GMFCS, qism aur distribution, phir ghar walon ke saath functional goals aur hips ki nigrani.
sections.I: Goals ke mutabiq ilaaj: chalne ke liye functional training, hemiplegia mein constraint-induced therapy, taaqat, fitness, orthoses aur 24 ghante posture management.
sections.K: Kuch bachchon mein FES aur hydrotherapy goals mein madad karti hain.
sections.M: GMFM, goal attainment scaling, range, chaal ki video aur participation dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. CP ki dimagh ki chot nahi barhti, lekin haddiyon aur muscles ke masle barh sakte hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
